lines.zh: 我在草地上走两步，啄一下。
lines.en: I take two steps and peck once.
My crest opens and closes.

lines.zh: 我用细长的喙探进土里。
lines.en: I probe the soil with my long bill.
I hop onto a stone.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀上有黑白条纹。
lines.en: My wings are barred black and white.
My stride is light on short claws.
I walk a stretch along the fence.
I search the grass roots for insects.
I stop and bob my head.
I walk over the mound of earth.
I open my wings and beat twice.
I go round the tree and keep searching.

lines.zh: 我的影子在地上一点一点的。
lines.en: My shadow bobs along the ground.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪到有阳光的地方。
lines.en: I move slowly into the sun.
I rummage through the fallen leaves.
I lift my head and shake my crest.

lines.zh: 我在篱笆桩边抓了两下。
lines.en: I scratch twice by the fence post.
I raise my bill and swallow an insect.
I stand with my crest folded.
I sink my bill into the soil and hold still.

lines.zh: 我在听土下面有没有动静。
lines.en: I listen for movement under the soil.
The wind ruffles my crest.
The hoopoe's crest shakes off sand.
The soil is loose here; easy to dig.
I preen the feathers on my breast.

lines.zh: 冠羽一张一合，我在地里找虫。
lines.en: Crest opening and closing, I probe the soil for grubs.

lines.zh: 阳光把我的翅膀照得发白。
lines.en: The sun bleaches my wings.
I have stayed in this area some days.
I turn over the soil you stepped on.
I tilt my head at you and my crest opens.
You are standing on my foraging ground.

lines.zh: 我这一身花纹很好看吧。
lines.en: These markings of mine are handsome, aren't they.
Is that thing in your hand moving?
I am not afraid of you; I can fly.

lines.zh: 你靴子上的泥，是从我的地里带的。
lines.en: The mud on your boots came from my patch.

lines.zh: 你踩草的声音，我刚听过。
lines.en: I just heard you crush that grass.

lines.zh: 你一动，草里的虫就跑了。
lines.en: When you move, the insects in the grass flee.
Trying to catch me? You will not.
I leap clear of the ground.
I give one short, startled cry.
I hop behind the stone.
A flick of my wings steadies me.
My crest has opened fully.

lines.zh: 我这小身子挨不了第二下。
lines.en: This small body cannot take a second.
I duck deeper into the grass.
Hey, careful with my long beak.
I hear insects in the soil.
That thing is moving; I want it.
I take two steps over.
Put it on the ground; don't hold it.
I can take it in one peck.
Better than insects.
I take it and step back.
There are more in the grass; I hear them.
A few insects are not one peck.
I will fly off when I am done.

lines.zh: 你的靴子差一点压到我。
lines.en: Your boot nearly caught me.
I leap and fly clear.

lines.zh: 这一下把我的冠羽撞乱了。
lines.en: That knocked my crest askew.
A bird cannot move a person.
I hop past your foot.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀扫到了你的手。
lines.en: My wing brushes your hand.
Hold still; I am still digging.

lines.zh: 撞到我了，我的羽冠乱了。
lines.en: You bumped me. My crest is a mess.

lines.zh: 我的冠羽不是为了那种事。
lines.en: My crest is not for that.
I am the only one on this lawn.
I must finish this meal first.
My crest has all stood up.
I tilt my head and my crest folds.
It waits for the tall grass.
I hear an insect; I am off.
The soil is more interesting.
I flap and hop away.
I will not take up that subject.
I pinch it up in my bill.
It is heavier than an insect.
I carry it aside.
I look; it is not food.
I drop it in the grass.
I nudge it twice with my bill.
This thing rolls.
Good; I will keep it.

lines.zh: 土下有东西，我把喙插进去。
lines.en: Something under the soil; I drive my bill in.
I point my bill at that grass.
I lower my head and fold my crest.
It is far bigger than an insect.
I do not care for it.
It is nearing my mound.
I hop onto a stone.
Its shadow is long.
I follow it, walking in the grass.
It takes a step; I hop.
I hide behind a clump of tall grass.
My markings hide well in the grass.
It stops; I peck at the soil.
It paid me no attention.

lines.zh: 我又啄了一下，装着找虫。
lines.en: I peck again, pretending to hunt.
It has moved some way off.
Only then do I relax my crest.
I peck its instep.
Not heavy, but sharp.
It lifts a foot and I take flight.
I land behind it.
I beat my wings at its face.
It backs off and I fly clear.
I land in the tree to catch my breath.
Good; it did not follow.
I land on a stretch of grass.
First I shake out my wings.

lines.zh: 我落地，先看看有没有虫。
lines.en: I land and check for grubs first.

lines.zh: 我把冠羽打开，看看四周。
lines.en: I open my crest and look around.
I smell insects.
Two steps, one peck.
Good sun, light wind.
I tidy my breast feathers with my bill.
Someone is nearby.
I hop onto a stone to look.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的羽毛，卷起来了。
lines.en: Fire curls my feathers.

lines.zh: 水浸透羽毛，我飞不起来。
lines.en: Water soaks my feathers and I cannot fly.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀进灌木，冠羽全乱。
lines.en: Blast threw me into the bushes, crest a mess.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我羽冠全竖。
lines.en: That force stands my crest right up.
No insects in the soil; I am hungry.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我整只鸟都白了。
lines.en: The flash turns me white all over.
I fall, wings beating at nothing.
